snippet.title: Fakutori | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming 2026 - Wishlist Now on Steam: https://mythwright.gg/Fakutori-YT

If factory games have always looked interesting but never felt approachable, Fakutori is your way in. Just don’t be surprised at how deep the rabbit hole goes…

Fakutori is a relaxing automation game that’s easy to pick up and hard to put down. Place your machines, discover new elements, and watch your factory grow in ways you never imagined. Whether it's your first factory game or you're already an expert builder, Fakutori's infinite world and constraints-free gameplay will satisfy that automation itch!
